prompt: A photorealistic, vertical shot of a massive, bipedal heavy-duty robot standing in an outdoor urban plaza. The robot is constructed from complex industrial machinery, featuring exposed gears, hydraulic pistons, and segmented armor plating in white and dark grey. It has a head unit with multiple camera lenses and red warning lights on its shoulders. The text "警視庁 MPD" (Metropolitan Police Department) is printed on the chest plates and arm segments. The robot's large mechanical hands are holding a wooden pallet stacked with cardboard boxes labeled "災害支援物資" (Disaster Relief Supplies). Beside the robot is a flatbed truck loaded with cases of bottled water. Three police officers wearing dark blue uniforms with "警視庁 MPD" on their backs and helmets are present: one officer stands near the truck bed directing operations, while two others stand on the ground in the foreground. In the background, there is a large concrete building with Japanese signage reading "区立総合体育館" (Ward General Gymnasium), along with white tents also marked "災害支援" (Disaster Support). Stacks of green pipes or barriers are visible in the bottom right corner.

promptZh: 一张照片级写实的竖构图照片，画面中一台巨大的双足重型机器人伫立在户外城市广场上。机器人由复杂的工业机械结构打造而成，裸露的齿轮、液压活塞以及白深灰相间的分段式装甲板清晰可见。它的头部单元装有多个摄像头镜头，肩部配有红色警示灯。胸甲与手臂部件上印有“警視庁 MPD”（东京警视厅）字样。机器人硕大的机械双手正托举着一个木质托盘，上面堆叠着标有“災害支援物資”（灾害救援物资）字样的纸箱。机器人身旁停着一辆平板卡车，车上满载着一箱箱瓶装水。现场有三名警察，他们头戴头盔，身穿深蓝色制服，背后印有“警視庁 MPD”标识：一名警员站在卡车车厢旁指挥作业，另外两名则站在前景处的地面上。背景中是一栋大型混凝土建筑，带有日文标牌“区立総合体育館”（区立综合体育馆），旁边还搭有几顶同样标有“災害支援”（灾害支援）字样的白色帐篷。画面右下角可以看到成堆的绿色管道或隔离栏。
